subject: run-perl-suite: a file that kills the run produces NO row and exit 0 (op/list.t) — silent hole in the release signal
description:
DONE s319.  The s318 hypothesis (parent OOM-killed, systemd swallows the
status) was WRONG.  Probing found three composing defects:

1. A forked WORKER inherited the parent's $SIG{TERM} handler AND its END
   blocks, so a signalled worker ran `exit 130` -> the parent's
   `END { system("rm -rf $tmpdir") }` + `END { unlink $core }`, destroying
   every sibling's result file and the shared saved core; its inherited
   %children copy also made it kill -KILL the siblings' process groups.
2. The parent then died in tempfile(DIR => $tmpdir) -> no summary, no tsv.
3. `system()` in an END block overwrites $?, and $? at the end of the LAST
   END block is the process exit status -> the die's 255 became 0.  Not
   crash-conditional: this zeroed the exit code of EVERY run, so the
   documented "Exit: nonzero iff any DIFF/..." contract never held at all.

PROOF (all reproduced, not inferred):
 - probe: a TERMed child runs the parent's END and wipes the shared dir;
 - `END { system("true") } exit(1)` -> 0;  same with die -> 0;
 - counterfactual: TERMing ONE worker at HEAD killed the run at file 2 of 5
   ("Error in tempfile() ... Parent directory does not exist").  With the
   fix the same kill yields NO-RESULT for that file and the rest still run.
 - systemd: a cgroup OOM stop sends SIGTERM (scope exit 143), so it IS
   catchable; only a direct SIGKILL of the parent (137) escapes END.

FIX (tools/run-perl-suite.pl): report from an END block -> one row per
requested file always, KILLED (in flight) / NOT-RUN (never started), both
UNEXPLAINED so exit is nonzero and the tsv is complete + headed
"# INCOMPLETE RUN"; workers reset INT/TERM to DEFAULT; every destructive END
guarded by `$$ == $MAIN_PID`; cleanup ENDs take `local $?`; rows appended to
$faillog/run-journal.tsv as they arrive (survives SIGKILL, tail -f-able)
with a "# complete" trailer.  Same $MAIN_PID + local $? guard applied to
sweep-perl-tests.pl (uncaught die in a worker had the same wipe available).

VERIFIED: exit 1 on DIFF / exit 0 all-OK (both were 0 before); parent-kill ->
3 OK + KILLED + NOT-RUN, exit 130; worker-kill -> NO-RESULT and the run
continues; sweep smoke test unchanged (lc.t 82/0).

STILL OPEN (unchanged by this): op/list.t and op/pack.t have no measured row.
A full re-run needs room or --jobs 2-4 — but now a short run says so.
